# duress

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Idle blocker `duress`: a fresh host duress latch keeps the host busy, and asks to be re-read when its lease could lapse (a lapse emits no event). On main, a watch on the latch dir asks for a re-evaluation when duress starts or ends.
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host.idle-blocker` "duress"
- Machine:
  - Register: `defineFileWatcher('host-idle.duress-latch')`
